content: Listen with the ear of your heart, not just with the ear of your head.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: The ear of the analytical head listens only for logic, grammatical accuracy, and ammunition to form a clever debate response. But the ear of the heart listens for the unspoken ache, the trembling vulnerability, and the longing beneath the words. Listen to heal.
practicalInsight: Listen to a loved one or friend today without analyzing or attempting to fix their problem. Just hold compassionate space.
reflectionPrompt: Are you listening to the people around you with the cold intellect of the head, or the warm empathy of the heart?
